eventDetail.scope: Smart City USA 2026 is a premier one-day conference uniting government officials, industry leaders, and technical experts to collaborate on smart city topics, including innovative urban solutions, development insights, and practical use cases. This conference categorizes its content across six technical tracks: Smart Mobility & Transportation, IoT & Edge Computing, AI & Big Data in Urban Environments, Sustainable Energy, Smart Urban Infrastructure, and Smart Government. The event focuses on urban innovations that advance the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in mobility, digital transformation, energy, infrastructure, and governance. All submissions will be evaluated by domain experts for their technical depth, innovation, and contribution to at least one SDG, ensuring that speakers and participants address measurable societal outcomes.
